name: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
review: I really enjoyed this. Took me a while to chew through it, but not for lack of being very engaged the whole time. I enjoyed every character’s point of view when it switched between them. The world building has so much going on that it successfully answers by the end - while leaving many many other things tantalizingly out of reach. I look forward to continuing through the Stormlight series.
